text:
Predicates:
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
HaveTeeth(x) ::: x has teeth.
Platypus(x) ::: x is a platypus.
Humans(x) ::: x is a human.
NoTeeth(x) ::: x has no teeth.

Premises:
Some mammals have teeth.
Platypus(x) ∧ Mammal(x) ∧ ¬HaveTeeth(x) ::: Platypuses have no teeth and are mammals.
Humans(x) ∧ HaveTeeth(x) ::: Humans have teeth.

Conclusion:
Platypus(x) ∧ Mammal(x) ∧ ¬HaveTeeth(x) ::: Platypuses are mammals with no teeth.
